elements.name: Jupiter
elements.text: Jupiter: expansion, luck, and abundance, the guiding, generous energy that can tip into excess if unchecked.

elements.name: Falling devil figure
elements.text: The red figure tumbling down the wheel's rim: misfortune as just one passing phase, not a permanent fate.

elements.name: Rising angel figure
elements.text: The winged figure ascending on the opposite side: fortune's rise mirroring the fall, the wheel's constant turning.

rounds.text: The Wheel marks a turning point in the journey, the moment personal choice starts shaping {b1}. Fortune and misfortune are simply {b2}, each one closing a cycle and opening another. From here, the Major Arcana takes on a more spiritual tone. Jupiter, its ruling planet, brings expansion, generosity, and guidance, its very name meaning 'guru' in Hindi. Even abundance needs balance, like standing steady atop a turning wheel.
